_comment: Vulkan loader ICD manifest. Install to /usr/local/share/vulkan/icd.d/atrium_icd.json (FreeBSD) or /usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/atrium_icd.json (Linux). Tells libvulkan.so.1 where to find the atrium-vk-icd cdylib and what Vulkan API version it claims. api_version will move forward as more entry points are implemented.
